Dear Doctor,

I reviewed this 25-year-old man in the medical clinic today. His background includes hypertension.

He is allergic to animal dander, which causes hay fever symptoms and hives. He is allergic to fish, which causes hay fever symptoms and skin rash. He is allergic to grass pollen. He is allergic to house dust mite. He is allergic to mould. He is allergic to tree pollen.

He takes fluticasone 44 mcg twice a day. He takes fentanyl 25 mcg as a patch changed every 72 hours. He is on paracetamol and oxycodone when needed. He continues on hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg once a day. He continues on salbutamol 90 mcg when needed. He takes amlodipine 2.5 mg once a day. He continues on lisinopril 10 mg once a day.

Plan: no changes today. Review in clinic in three months.

Yours sincerely,
Medical Outpatient Clinic
